articles.title: Kaun Banega Crorepati 17: Contestant duo Vinita Kene and husband Sunil Dharmale answer the Rs 2 lakh question incorrectly, take home Rs 25,000
articles.summary: In Kaun Banega Crorepati 17, contestant duo Vinita Kene and Sunil Dharmale faced a setback, answering the Rs 2 lakh question incorrectly. articles.title: Margin trading book at record high in Nov, but growth rate dips
articles.summary: Margin Trading Funding (MTF), a facility allowing investors to borrow for share purchases, hit an all-time high in November in Mumbai. Although borrowing reached record levels, the article suggests a complex growth pace, offering insights for SSB aspirants analyzing national economic trends and financial market dynamics.

articles.title: Science in 2026: the events to watch for in the coming year

articles.title: Previewing 2026 Free Agent Offensive Lineman
articles.summary: The Las Vegas Raiders' offensive line is critically underperforming, ranking poorly across key NFL metrics. They are near the bottom in pass block win rate, last in run block win rate, and 30th in pressure allowed. These severe weaknesses in blocking capabilities significantly hinder quarterback protection and the running game, negatively impacting the team's overall offensive potential in the league.
